label: Nothing that is being moved in a respect…, from Each of the two uses of 'in act' in the… and 4 more
meaning: Optional summary over IN-ACT_1-3 (joint sense fork) for the prima via step. Coverage reads both uses of 'in act' (the mover is in act; nothing is in act and in potency in the same respect) in selected senses among formal, virtual and formal-or-virtual act; exclusivity makes them one sense. Whichever it is, a self-mover in a respect in which it is moved would be in potency there and in act there in that one sense, which non-simultaneity excludes. The controls give the mixed reading (mover virtually in act, non-simultaneity formal) with self-motion: the step needs one sense, not a particular one.
